rows.en: Be sure to come back again!
rows.notes: Klan working as a waitress, to customers. Also Pinon in ext_pnn_004 (same situation).

rows.en: ...Phew...
rows.notes: Also Pinon and Sheryl after the same waitress shift.

rows.en: Th-Thanks for all your hard work...
I'm sorry things turned out like this.

It was good exercise!
For a moment there, I wasn't sure how
things would turn out, though.

And I got to see you in a Nyan-Nyan uniform,
Klan-senpai!
rows.notes: Japanese addresses her by name in third person; made it 'you ..., Klan-senpai' since she is right there.

rows.en: ...Mmph...
It looked good on you.
...Thank you.
rows.notes: Also Pinon (same scene) and the player in nml_myk_008 (thanking Shirakawa for helping them up).

rows.en: W-Well then, we're going home!

I'd go in by myself, though~
In that case, why don't we go in together?
Th-That's way too many, isn't it!?
rows.notes: Female variant of c01482 (15 orders of maguro buns).

rows.en: You just ordered way too many maguro buns...
I-I don't have that kind of money!

I've heard the rumors...
Rumors that you've been hanging out
with that man a lot!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'ano otoko' is never identified in the scene; kept as 'that man'.

rows.en:
(Now that I'm in the New U.N. Forces,
I've got to get my act together...)
rows.notes: Player has joined the military (not S.M.S.).

rows.en: \p-kun.
Hello, Cathy-san.
That uniform looks pretty good on you.
Oh, your necktie is crooked.
Huh, is it?
...There, that's better.

I'm expecting great things from you, you know?
Do your best for me.

Great things? From me...?
I'm nothing special...

There's no need to be modest.
I've looked over your file.
Huh, you have?

You caught my eye, being a student
from Mihoshi, of all places.
rows.notes: 'ano Mihoshi' = Mihoshi, the famous one; the next line has the player wonder whether Mihoshi is an amazing school.

rows.en: I see...

(Is Mihoshi actually some kind of
amazing school?)

We'll be backing you up too, so you'll never
regret choosing the military over S.M.S.
I look forward to seeing you excel.
(All right! I'm gonna do my best!!)
\p-san.
rows.notes: Cathy (female player) and Luca (both genders) in frd_luk_001.

rows.en: Oh, your tie is crooked.

Great things? From me...?
I'm nothing special...
rows.notes: Female (watashi) version of c01524; same English.

rows.en: (Guess I'll do some shopping on the way home...)
Huh... Who's that over there...?
Oh, \p-kun.
Doing some shopping, Cathy-san?
Yes, I just felt like doing some cooking.
O-Oh, really~?

(Funny, Cathy-san seems like such
a career woman...)
That face says you didn't expect that...
Wh-What? Not at all!
Believe it or not, cooking is my hobby.
What's your best dish?
Let me see...
I'd say my best is pineapple cake, after all.
Pineapple cake...
(Didn't somebody really love that...?)
rows.notes: Unnamed 'someone' (implicitly Ozma); kept vague as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
I've been making it for ages.
You wouldn't know, but it was quite a hit.
Huh~
rows.notes: x21 generic 'hee~' reaction (player and Luca); 'Huh~' fits the doubtful reading here and the interested one elsewhere.

rows.en: You don't seem to believe me.
Of course I do! How could I not?
rows.notes: 'sonna wake nai ja nai desu ka' = no way that's true (that I don't believe you).

rows.en:
Just kidding.
I'll bring you some next time, so give it a try.
Okay! I'll be looking forward to it!
Well then, see you later.
rows.notes: x16: Cathy, Ranka, Claire, Shirakawa partings.

rows.en: (Is pineapple cake the next big craze?)
Oh, \p-san.

(Cathy-san seems like such a career woman,
though...)

uncertain: c01515: Klan's 'ano otoko' (that man) is never identified; kept 'that man' for both player genders.
